title: Generated images are shown inline in the conversation

categories.prompt: A task creates an image with the built-in generate_image tool or an MCP image tool; the image is visible in the conversation without expanding a step.

executableTestNames: surfaces built-in generate_image output as an image card anchored at creation
surfaces MCP-saved images, including legacy screenshot-typed MCP events
does not surface browser screenshots or MCP videos
skips an image card when an assistant answer already embeds the image inline
skips an image card when an assistant answer links the image (the link shows a thumbnail)
keeps image cards from crowding out file cards and estimates their taller height

categories.prompt: The final answer links a workspace image, e.g. [Download the banner](banner.png); the link renders with an inline thumbnail (not in step titles), and %20 names resolve.

executableTestNames: adds an inline thumbnail after a link to a workspace image
does not add thumbnails for non-image or remote links
can disable link thumbnails for compact event titles
keeps ![]() image embeds rendering through the image preview only

categories.prompt: An MCP image-generation tool returns image content; it is logged as type image with a tool-based file name and a hint to embed it.

executableTestNames: names generated MCP images after the tool, logs them as images, and asks for inline display

notes: Before: generated images appeared only as file links (preview hidden in a collapsed step row; MCP images typed as screenshots render as plain links in summary mode; markdown image links had no preview), and the link thumbnail frame left an empty strip next to wide images. After: an image card appears where the image was created, links to images get thumbnails, and the final answer's embed renders inline.
